```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("HBR_litterfall_2009-2022_preprocessed.csv")

summary(raw_data)
head(raw_data)

```

```{r}
new_data <- raw_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Season, Site, Stand, Treatment, Total_Mass_g_m2) %>%
  filter(Season == "Fall") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Total_Mass_g_m2)) %>% 
  group_by(Year, Season, Site, Stand, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(Mass_gm2 = mean(Total_Mass_g_m2)) 

new_data
write.csv(new_data, "HBR_litterfall_2009-2022_processed.csv")
```
